description: Localization (i18n) resource file for the Select2 plugin in Spanish (es). It provides Spanish translations for various user interface messages related to the Select2 dropdown component.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns Spanish message indicating failure to load results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns Spanish message instructing user to remove excess characters when input exceeds maximum length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns Spanish message instructing user to input additional characters when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns Spanish message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns Spanish message indicating the maximum number of elements that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns Spanish message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns Spanish message indicating a search is in progress.
